A shared memory for your agents and your team

MCP pulls context from your Team Space too. So user research, sales calls and recurring team meetings from across your company are available in your AI app of choice.

MCP is off by default for enterprises, and admins decide whether to turn it on.

Visit Enterprise page

How it works

1. Open the Connect tab in Granola

2. Choose your AI app and sign in

3. Ask anything, or put your agent to work

New tools for your agents

Smart Search

Find the detail without reading the whole transcript

Agents pull the exact passage that answers the question, cited back to the meeting. 44% faster. 85% fewer tokens.

why did Northwind push back on pricing?

search_transcripts

Write tools

Put your agents to work inside Granola

Ask Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent to write an agenda, apply a template, or file notes into folders. For 1 meeting or 100s.

Context that keeps itself up to date

Helping busy people through busy days

Questions and answers

Model Context Protocol is how AI apps plug into other tools. USB-C for context. Connect Granola once, and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and the rest can work from your meeting notes instead of waiting for you to paste them in.

Yes, for questions about your meetings. What was said, what was decided, what to do next. Use MCP when you are already in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and you want those tools to know what you have been talking about.

No. Granola notes are structured around people, decisions, and intent. When an agent needs more, Smart Search pulls the exact passages that answer the question and cites them back to the meeting, so it doesn't have to read whole transcripts. That makes it 44% faster and uses 85% fewer tokens. Transcripts stay the source of truth, and your agent can open the full thing when exact wording matters. How we built it.

Only when you ask it to. Write tools let an agent add an agenda or prep to a note, apply a template, and file notes into folders. Your transcripts are never edited. Enterprise admins can turn write tools off.

Official connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Figma, Copilot, Mistral, Grok and more. Any app that can use an MCP server can connect with https://mcp.granola.ai/mcp. See the integrations page, or the setup guide.

Free covers the last 30 days of your own notes. Business adds your full history, workspace notes, transcripts, and write tools. On Enterprise, admins decide who gets access and what agents can do.

Take as many notes as you’d like. Upgrade to view and work with notes older than 30 days.
